key_insight: WiMoT enables replay-free continual Wi-Fi sensing by transporting stored class means and covariances through an affine feature update instead of retaining earlier CSI samples.
engineering_relevance: For privacy- and storage-constrained wireless sensing nodes—not solid-mechanics constitutive models—WiMoT supports learning new rooms or users while preserving earlier-domain accuracy.
method: Store per-class feature means and covariances for each earlier domain.
Learn an affine update on a frozen feature basis, transporting stored moments while balancing new-domain learning and earlier-class separation.
Refit a Gaussian discriminant classifier with equal domain weighting; predict without domain identity.
evidence_signal: Across 3DO, WiMANS, and Widar3.0, reported final accuracies are 94.02%, 89.61%, and 95.16%, with at most 0.58 percentage points of forgetting; rank-32 covariance storage uses 6.4% of full moment memory with at most 0.49 points of accuracy loss.
watch_item: Restricting representation changes to an affine map on a frozen basis may limit adaptation to shifts beyond those evaluated.
paper_title: WiMoT: Replay-Free Continual Wi-Fi Sensing via Moment Transport
